generate_python_docs: run the docgen script to build Python documentation using Sphinx and setup.py
push_docs_to_github: push generated Python documentation to a GitHub repo branch using --repo-owner and --doc-branch
setup_virtualenv_for_docs: create a virtualenv and install dependencies for documentation generation when no VIRTUAL_ENV is set
install_sphinx_dependencies: install pip, requirements, and Sphinx into the virtualenv before building docs
configure_doc_branch: set a custom documentation branch name using the --doc-branch argument with a version string
